description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'SecurityUtil' for security-related functions within the Apache OFBiz framework, including permission checks, JWT token handling, and security sanitization methods.

classes.name: SecurityUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing security functions such as permission checks, JWT handling, and security sanitization within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: hasUserLoginAdminPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user login has at least one admin permission.

methods.name: hasUserLoginMorePermissionThan
methods.description: Determines if one user login has more permissions than another, returning missing permissions.

methods.name: checkMultiLevelAdminPermissionValidity
methods.description: Checks if a permission is valid based on multi-level admin permission hierarchy.

methods.name: generateJwtToAuthenticateUserLogin
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for user login authentication, salted with user ID and current password.

methods.name: authenticateUserLoginByJWT
methods.description: Validates a JWT token against a user login ID to verify coherence.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Detects potential Freemarker template injection in request parameters or content.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Checks if a string contains Freemarker interpolation patterns, used to prevent exploits.
